summary: A one-screen poster site: a 2×2 grid of saturated colour fields, each naming one optical-size subfamily of NaN Serf (Display, Headline, Text, Micro) in its own opsz, while a huge blurred squiggle in difference blend draws itself across the quadrants. The only other element is a 'Download trial fonts' sticker.

instances.look: Four flat quadrants (red, magenta, green, blue) each centring 'NaN Serf / Display|Headline|Text|Micro' in a contrasting quadrant colour; a fat, soft-edged scribble stroke in difference blend sweeps over them, inverting colours where it passes
instances.feel: Loud, joyful, poster-like; the serif feels unexpectedly pop
instances.ux: Nothing scrolls: the screen is the whole site (wheel events only advance the squiggle animation in the capture). Blocks 01–02 are later states of the same screen
instances.learn: Let colour and one ambient gesture carry a single screen; naming each optical size in its own opsz makes the family structure the whole message

reconstruction.layout: 100vw × 100vh grid, 2 columns × 2 rows of equal 720×450 cells; each cell centres a two-line label; sticker fixed bottom-right (~175×70px, 20px from the edges); full-screen SVG squiggles (viewBox 800×600, width/height 100%) layered above the grid
reconstruction.typography: Labels ~64px NaN Serf A variable, Regular (wght 400), two lines 'NaN Serf' / subfamily, leading ~1.05, centred; each cell sets its own opsz: Display opsz 100, Headline 60, Text 18, Micro 8; sticker text ~10px NaN Holo Mono caps, white
reconstruction.behaviour: Several thick blurred SVG paths (class 'difference squiggle', mix-blend-mode difference) draw in and out in a loop (stroke-dash animation), so the overlap with each quadrant changes colour; label colours change between passes; a 'variablicious' keyframe animates opsz/wght; data-initial on each cell plus texts.js suggests clicking a cell swaps the name for sample text (not verified)
reconstruction.content: Only the family and subfamily names; texts.js likely holds alternate sample copy
reconstruction.assets: Hand-drawn squiggle paths (SVG); blob-shaped sticker SVG
reconstruction.html: main > div.serf-o.NaN-Serf-{Display|Headline|Text|Micro}-Regular[data-family][data-weight][data-initial] > span; svg.difference.squiggle × 8 (paths duplicated for a soft halo); aside#trials > a > svg blob

instances.look: The same 2×2 grid read as a family map: one cell per optical-size subfamily, each label set in that cut so the contrast drops from Display (fine hairlines) to Micro (sturdy, wide)
instances.ux: static reading; the grid is the hero itself
instances.learn: Four optical sizes at one identical point size expose how the drawing changes with opsz better than a waterfall would

reconstruction.layout: 2×2 equal cells filling the viewport, label centred in each; on mobile the cells stack into four 100vw bands
reconstruction.typography: All labels the same ~64px; only opsz differs (100 / 60 / 18 / 8) at wght 400, so contrast and spacing visibly change from cell to cell
reconstruction.behaviour: none of its own (shares the hero's squiggle)

instances.look: A magenta blob-shaped sticker in the bottom-right corner with 'DOWNLOAD / TRIAL FONTS' in small white mono caps; never cut as its own block, attached here
instances.feel: Off-hand, like a sticker on a poster
instances.ux: The only link on the page, to nan.xyz/trial-fonts
instances.learn: On a poster-site, a single sticker-shaped CTA can sit on top of the composition without needing a nav bar

reconstruction.layout: Fixed bottom-right, ~175×70px irregular rounded blob (SVG path), slightly rotated, ~20px from the corner; text centred in two lines
reconstruction.typography: ~10px NaN Holo Mono uppercase, white, tracked
